ai_settings_text_config_length_check.name: ai_settings_text_config_length_check
ai_settings_text_config_length_check.value: (text_provider is null or length(trim(text_provider)) between 1 and 100) and (text_model is null or length(trim(text_model)) between 1 and 200)

channel_settings_text_length_check.name: channel_settings_text_length_check
channel_settings_text_length_check.value: (niche is null or length(trim(niche)) between 1 and 500) and (target_audience is null or length(trim(target_audience)) between 1 and 500) and (tone is null or length(trim(tone)) between 1 and 500) and (content_pillar is null or length(trim(content_pillar)) between 1 and 500) and (default_cta is null or length(trim(default_cta)) between 1 and 500) and (affiliate_disclosure is null or length(trim(affiliate_disclosure)) between 1 and 500)

fact_lock_claim_review_check.name: fact_lock_claim_review_check
fact_lock_claim_review_check.value: ("fact_lock_claim"."classification_status" = 'SUPPORTED' and "fact_lock_claim"."review_status" = 'AUTO_PASSED') or ("fact_lock_claim"."classification_status" = 'NEEDS_REVIEW' and "fact_lock_claim"."review_status" in ('UNRESOLVED', 'MANUAL_APPROVED')) or ("fact_lock_claim"."classification_status" in ('UNSUPPORTED', 'PROHIBITED') and "fact_lock_claim"."review_status" = 'UNRESOLVED')

fact_lock_claim_review_metadata_check.name: fact_lock_claim_review_metadata_check
fact_lock_claim_review_metadata_check.value: (("fact_lock_claim"."review_status" = 'MANUAL_APPROVED' and "fact_lock_claim"."reviewed_by_user_id" is not null and "fact_lock_claim"."reviewed_at" is not null) or ("fact_lock_claim"."review_status" in ('AUTO_PASSED', 'UNRESOLVED') and "fact_lock_claim"."reviewed_by_user_id" is null and "fact_lock_claim"."reviewed_at" is null))

fact_lock_run_token_check.name: fact_lock_run_token_check
fact_lock_run_token_check.value: ("fact_lock_run"."input_tokens" is null or "fact_lock_run"."input_tokens" >= 0) and ("fact_lock_run"."output_tokens" is null or "fact_lock_run"."output_tokens" >= 0)

fact_lock_run_cost_check.name: fact_lock_run_cost_check
fact_lock_run_cost_check.value: ("fact_lock_run"."estimated_cost_micros" is null or "fact_lock_run"."estimated_cost_micros" >= 0) and ("fact_lock_run"."actual_cost_micros" is null or "fact_lock_run"."actual_cost_micros" >= 0)

fact_lock_run_currency_check.name: fact_lock_run_currency_check
fact_lock_run_currency_check.value: (("fact_lock_run"."estimated_cost_micros" is null and "fact_lock_run"."actual_cost_micros" is null and "fact_lock_run"."currency" is null) or (("fact_lock_run"."estimated_cost_micros" is not null or "fact_lock_run"."actual_cost_micros" is not null) and "fact_lock_run"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'))

fact_lock_run_finished_shape_check.name: fact_lock_run_finished_shape_check
fact_lock_run_finished_shape_check.value: ("fact_lock_run"."status" = 'pending' and "fact_lock_run"."finished_at" is null) or ("fact_lock_run"."status" <> 'pending' and "fact_lock_run"."finished_at" is not null)

product_fact_date_order_check.name: product_fact_date_order_check
product_fact_date_order_check.value: "product_fact"."confirmed_at" is null or "product_fact"."expires_at" is null or "product_fact"."confirmed_at" <= "product_fact"."expires_at"

product_fact_history_date_order_check.name: product_fact_history_date_order_check
product_fact_history_date_order_check.value: "product_fact_history"."confirmed_at" is null or "product_fact_history"."expires_at" is null or "product_fact_history"."confirmed_at" <= "product_fact_history"."expires_at"

script_generation_mode_parent_check.name: script_generation_mode_parent_check
script_generation_mode_parent_check.value: ("script_generation"."mode" = 'full' and "script_generation"."parent_generation_id" is null) or ("script_generation"."mode" = 'repair' and "script_generation"."parent_generation_id" is not null)

script_generation_status_output_check.name: script_generation_status_output_check
script_generation_status_output_check.value: ("script_generation"."status" in ('completed', 'partial') and "script_generation"."output_json" is not null) or ("script_generation"."status" in ('pending', 'failed', 'indeterminate') and "script_generation"."output_json" is null)

script_generation_status_finished_check.name: script_generation_status_finished_check
script_generation_status_finished_check.value: ("script_generation"."status" = 'pending' and "script_generation"."finished_at" is null) or ("script_generation"."status" <> 'pending' and "script_generation"."finished_at" is not null)

script_generation_state_shape_check.name: script_generation_state_shape_check
script_generation_state_shape_check.value:
(
			("script_generation"."status" = 'completed' and "script_generation"."output_json" is not null and cardinality("script_generation"."valid_sections") = 8 and cardinality("script_generation"."invalid_sections") = 0 and ("script_generation"."valid_sections" || "script_generation"."invalid_sections") @> ARRAY['hook','voiceover','scenes','cta','caption','hashtags','disclosure','claims']::text[])
			or ("script_generation"."status" = 'partial' and "script_generation"."output_json" is not null and cardinality("script_generation"."valid_sections") > 0 and cardinality("script_generation"."invalid_sections") > 0 and cardinality("script_generation"."valid_sections" || "script_generation"."invalid_sections") = 8 and ("script_generation"."valid_sections" || "script_generation"."invalid_sections") @> ARRAY['hook','voiceover','scenes','cta','caption','hashtags','disclosure','claims']::text[])
			or ("script_generation"."status" = 'failed' and "script_generation"."output_json" is null and cardinality("script_generation"."valid_sections") = 0)
			or "script_generation"."status" in ('pending', 'indeterminate')
		)

script_generation_sections_unique_check.name: script_generation_sections_unique_check
script_generation_sections_unique_check.value: cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'hook')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'hook')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'voiceover')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'voiceover')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'scenes')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'scenes')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'cta')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'cta')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'caption')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'caption')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'hashtags')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'hashtags')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'disclosure')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'disclosure')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."valid_sections", 'claims')) <= 1 and cardinality(array_positions("script_generation"."invalid_sections", 'claims')) <= 1

script_generation_cost_currency_check.name: script_generation_cost_currency_check
script_generation_cost_currency_check.value: (("script_generation"."estimated_cost_micros" is null and "script_generation"."actual_cost_micros" is null and "script_generation"."currency" is null) or (("script_generation"."estimated_cost_micros" is not null or "script_generation"."actual_cost_micros" is not null) and "script_generation"."currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'))

script_version_status_shape_check.name: script_version_status_shape_check
script_version_status_shape_check.value: ("script_version"."status" = 'draft' and "script_version"."version_number" is null and "script_version"."saved_at" is null) or ("script_version"."status" = 'saved' and "script_version"."version_number" is not null and "script_version"."version_number" > 0 and "script_version"."saved_at" is not null)

voice_segment_artifact_audio_metadata_ch.name: voice_segment_artifact_audio_metadata_check
voice_segment_artifact_audio_metadata_ch.value: ("voice_segment_artifact"."byte_size" is null or "voice_segment_artifact"."byte_size" > 0) and ("voice_segment_artifact"."duration_ms" is null or "voice_segment_artifact"."duration_ms" > 0)

voice_segment_artifact_finished_shape_ch.name: voice_segment_artifact_finished_shape_check
voice_segment_artifact_finished_shape_ch.value: ("voice_segment_artifact"."status" = 'pending' and "voice_segment_artifact"."finished_at" is null) or ("voice_segment_artifact"."status" <> 'pending' and "voice_segment_artifact"."finished_at" is not null)

voice_segment_artifact_completed_shape_c.name: voice_segment_artifact_completed_shape_check
voice_segment_artifact_completed_shape_c.value: ("voice_segment_artifact"."status" <> 'completed') or ("voice_segment_artifact"."storage_provider" is not null and "voice_segment_artifact"."storage_key" is not null and "voice_segment_artifact"."mime_type" = 'audio/mpeg' and "voice_segment_artifact"."byte_size" > 0 and "voice_segment_artifact"."checksum" is not null and "voice_segment_artifact"."duration_ms" > 0)
